name: Manual quote-level amount-based (line-level) discount
expected: NetUnitPrice = 50000 - 5000 = 45000; NetTotalPrice = 45000 * 2 = 90000; TotalPrice = 90000; ListPrice/UnitPrice = 50000. Discount applies ONCE off list price and must be idempotent across repeated reprices.
actual: ADVERSARIAL RE-MEASURE on a FRESH fixture (not the reused run2/run3 record) confirms the defect: built fresh Draft quote 0Q0WC000003Fs1Z0AS / QLI 0QLWC000003l1zp4AA (list=50000, DiscountAmount=5000, Qty=2, USD, non-derived OneTime). Reprice #1 (Force) -> NetUnitPrice=45000, NetTotalPrice=90000, TotalPrice=90000, TotalAdjustmentAmount=-10000, Source_List_Price__c=null, Base_Price__c=null (CORRECT). Reprice #2 (same record, no edits) -> NetUnitPrice=40000, NetTotalPrice=80000, TotalPrice=80000, TotalAdjustmentAmount=-20000, Source_List_Price__c=45000, Base_Price__c=45000, Pre_Partner_Price__c=45000, Quote.Discount rollup 10->20. The $5000 amount discount compounded against the prior discounted net (45000) instead of the list price (50000). Original disputed record 0QLWC000003km9Z4AQ remains at NetUnitPrice=40000 on re-query.
evidence: FRESH repro Quote 0Q0WC000003Fs1Z0AS (https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003Fs1Z0AS/view), QLI 0QLWC000003l1zp4AA. Reprice = POST /services/data/v67.0/connect/rev/sales-transaction/actions/place pricingPref=Force, isSuccess=true. Reprice#1 NetUnitPrice=45000; reprice#2 NetUnitPrice=40000 (Source_List_Price__c/Base_Price__c=45000 = the prior discounted net used as the discount base). Disputed original QLI 0QLWC000003km9Z4AQ on Quote 0Q0WC000003Fckn0AC still NetUnitPrice=40000. Snapshot: Data/pricing-v21-validation/h01_reverify/fresh_qli_after_reprice2.json. V21 active design 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY retrieved live (proc_retrieve/) 2026-06-30; org FortraUAT v67.0.
defectStep: ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel (BKM, actionType=ManualDiscount, ListContainer-group seq run after seq21) consumes InputUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice and AdjustmentValue=ItemDiscountAmount, outputting NetUnitPrice=InputUnitPrice-ItemDiscountAmount. The base is fed by SyncInputUnitPriceforDiscountBase/SyncInputUnitPricefromNet (top-level seq=13, AssignmentElement: InputUnitPrice <- NetUnitPrice). Root cause: for a DIRECT (non-partner) OneTime line, NetUnitPrice is never re-seeded back to ListPrice before discounting: 'OneTime Net Seed' (OneTimeNetSeedPrePartner seq19) uses IF(NetUnitPrice>0, NetUnitPrice, InputUnitPrice) so it PRESERVES the prior non-zero net, and 'Reset Net to Pre-Partner Base' (StampContributorBasePreDiscount seq14) only resets to ListPrice when PartnerDiscountPercent>0 (false here). So the persisted discounted net carries forward as the discount base and the $5000 compounds -$5000 on every reprice.
proposedFix: Re-seed the discount base from ListPrice for direct OneTime lines before the manual amount step runs (mirror the F-07 'Reset Net to Pre-Partner Base' / E-03 OneTime-seed pattern but make it fire for the non-partner case too): either change SyncInputUnitPricefromNet to assign InputUnitPrice <- ListPrice, or add a guarded reset NetUnitPrice <- ListPrice ahead of seq13 for non-derived OneTime non-partner lines. Must be idempotent (X=X fixed point). This makes 50000-5000=45000 on every reprice regardless of persisted NetUnitPrice. Same idempotency class as the already-designed F-07/E-03/G-03 fixes in V21_FIX_DESIGN.md.
regression: Same discount-compounding-on-reprice class as F-07 (partner ×0.85^N) and the E-03/G-03 idempotency fixes (see Data/pricing-v21-validation/V21_FIX_DESIGN.md). The amount-discount path was not covered by the F-07 PartnerDiscountPercent>0 reset nor the E-03 IF(NetUnitPrice>0) seed guard, so it still compounds. No external ticket id; provenance = catalog/proc design gap surfaced by V21 validation.
notes: Adversarial verification 2026-06-30. Ruled OUT TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT: defect reproduces on a brand-new fixture (reprice#1 correct at 45000, reprice#2 wrong at 40000), so it is NOT the stale-reused-record rollup that downgraded sibling H-02 to artifact. Ruled OUT EXPECTATION-ERROR: expected 45000 is correct and IS produced on the first reprice. Ruled OUT headless-$0 hydration: line hydrated to 45000, not $0/null. Preflight confirmed live: PBE 01uWC000005wru3YAA active, Fortra Price Book active, UnitPrice=50000, USD; Product2 01tWC00000DD1BiYAL 'DG Management Console' Fortra_Product_Type__c=Perpetual, ProductSellingModel SellingModelType=OneTime, non-derived; ManualQuoteLevelDiscount gate fired; amount branch ran on valid inputs. Mechanism traced in live retrieved V21: ManualQuoteLevelAmountBasedLineLevel InputUnitPrice=NetUnitPrice; OneTime Net Seed = IF(NetUnitPrice>0,NetUnitPrice,InputUnitPrice); Reset Net to Pre-Partner Base = IF(PartnerDiscountPercent>0, IF(Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c, NetUnitPrice, ListPrice), NetUnitPrice). NOTE: a single-reprice fresh build PASSES (45000); the defect requires a second reprice (any real rep re-editing/re-pricing a saved quote with an amount discount hits it).
verdict_reason: FRESH fixture repriced twice through the current active V21: reprice#1 NetUnitPrice=45000 (correct, idempotent expected), reprice#2 NetUnitPrice=40000 (expected 45000). Source_List_Price__c=Base_Price__c=Pre_Partner_Price__c=45000 confirm the amount step's base was the prior discounted net, not the 50000 list price. Inputs valid, intended non-derived OneTime branch fired, expected value correct, not a data/hydration artifact -> genuine PROCEDURE-DEFECT. The manual amount discount is not idempotent because no step re-seeds NetUnitPrice->ListPrice for a direct OneTime line before discounting, so the $5000 compounds on each reprice. Defect CONFIRMED.
